question: Which seated postures may the renunciant adopt for undisturbed practice?
premises: svastika and padma are named asana options
the practitioner should sit there undisturbed
inference: The verse permits sitting in svastika or padma posture, in an undisturbed manner.
uncertainties: svastika and padma are not defined in this verse
nirākulam may function adverbially rather than adjectivally
plain_english: He should sit there, in svastika or padma posture, undisturbed.
